name: Overwrite White.
source:
My younger twin brother's memories will be reset in a week.
Despite this, we've been spending each and every day in peace and quiet...
...or so I thought, until I discovered his secret.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10970]Freem![/url]]
